verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own ERP-oriented sync mechanism: the Card Expenses API retrieves approved card expenses and marks them as synced after they are ingested into an ERP or accounting system. The Bills API lets you create vendor bills, which allows data to flow back into Airwallex. However, this is an API you must build against, pull-based and limited to spend data. Nothing shows a native, real-time, bidirectional ERP connector that removes manual journal entries. Missing for 10: native ERP connectors (e.g., NetSuite/Xero/QuickBooks), real-time push sync into the ERP, documented bidirectional sync of ledger, transactions and reconciliation status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
